source_instruction: i'm looking for double sided hair extensions for hair care accessories.
query: Ugh, I stopped by the food court on my way over here and got the worst mango boba ever—tapioca was rock hard, the syrup tasted like artificial candy, and they didn’t even put the little mango jelly bits I asked for, total waste of 7 bucks. Also, the mall parking lot was a nightmare today, I circled for 20 minutes before someone pulled out of a spot right by the entrance, and some guy in a pickup almost backed into my car when I was walking in. Oh, and I saw the cutest corgi wearing a little rain jacket trotting by the entrance with its owner, it made the annoying parking situation almost worth it. Anyway, I need double-sided hair extensions in shade #ba2 | 60, and don’t go over that one for the price, yeah?
